Hollencrest Securities Llc decreased its stake in United Parcel Srvc Class B (UPS) by 0.91% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hollencrest Securities Llc sold 2,640 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.26% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 288,213 shares of the transportation company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $34.61 million, down from 290,853 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hollencrest Securities Llc who had been investing in United Parcel Srvc Class B for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $89.96B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.21% or $1.28   $104.41. About 3.73M shares traded. United Parcel Service, Inc. (NYSE:UPS) has risen 2.10%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 14.60% the S&P500.

It also reduced its holding in Vf Corp (NYSE:VFC) by 6,330 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 13,374 shares, and cut its stake in Celanese Corp (NYSE:CE).

UPS’s profit will be $1.33 billion for 16.95 P/E if the $1.54 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.67 actual earnings per share reported by United Parcel Service, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -7.78% negative EPS growth.
